steps.title: Build a character layer
steps.note: buildCharacterLayer expands a compact spec into the full character layer used by CreateAgentInput. It defines identity, role card, voice, progression, and avatar.

steps.title: Declarative agent definition
steps.note: The AgentDefinition interface lets callers supply name, description, instructions, capabilities, and a compact character spec. It mirrors the shape produced by CreateAgentForm.

steps.title: Define and validate
steps.note: defineAgent fills in canonical defaults, validates against the Zod schema, and optionally enforces the agent creation checklist. This is the single path for programmatic agent creation.
